title: Automotive ECU Published Process Capability Assessment Profile

management_decision.decision_title: Executive Authorization for Publication of Bounded ECU Level-1 Process Capability Profile
management_decision.approving_authority: jadzia (Project Lead & Assessment Sponsor, Team DeepSpace9)
management_decision.decision_text: Management formally authorizes the publication of the supported Automotive SPICE Level 1 Process Performance Profile for the Virtualized Automotive ECU Software increment (Baseline v0.6.0-rev1). The published profile accurately reflects the evidence-backed PA 1.1 ratings without asserting blanket organizational maturity or CL2 entry claims.

organizational_and_product_scope.product_description: Embedded safety-critical control and diagnostic application firmware for virtualized ECU platform.

assessment_methodology_and_governance.pam_version: Automotive SPICE PAM 3.1 / PAM 4.0 Reference Model (ISO/IEC 33020)
assessment_methodology_and_governance.assessment_method: Class 1 Rigorous Internal Assessment with Independent Readiness Review

boundary_and_claim_policy.claim_statement: The published ratings represent specific process performance (PA 1.1) achieved for the declared 15 process instances within the defined virtualized ECU software boundary. This publication does not constitute an organizational maturity rating, nor does it assert entry into Automotive SPICE Level 2 (Managed Process).

external_and_excluded_processes.reason: Hardware provided as virtualized target platform.
Kernel binary interface consumed as external contract.

assessment_disposition_statement.author: odo (Lead Assessor)
assessment_disposition_statement.statement: The assessment team confirms that the 15 evaluated software engineering, supporting, and project management process instances meet the performance requirements of PA 1.1 (Fully Achieved / F). Zero blocking nonconformances remain.

execution_responsibility_statement.author: jadzia (Project Lead & Assessment Sponsor)
execution_responsibility_statement.statement: Project management bears full execution responsibility for maintaining process adherence, tracking accepted residual risks, and executing the defined next-cycle improvements.

accepted_limitations.title: Virtualized Target Hardware Execution Environment
accepted_limitations.description: Emulated ARM Cortex-R52 target used for software qualification; physical EMC/dyno validation scheduled for v0.7.0.

accepted_limitations.title: External OS Kernel Boundary
accepted_limitations.description: POSIX/AUTOSAR kernel binary interface audited via ABI contract tests; internal kernel processes are external.

accepted_limitations.title: Internal Assessment Scope
accepted_limitations.description: Internal Class 1 assessment; formal third-party accredited audit recommended for OEM customer delivery.

next_cycle_improvement_plan.title: Commission Accredited Third-Party Class 1 Certification Assessment
next_cycle_improvement_plan.description: Engage an accredited external VDA / iNTACS auditing body to perform formal third-party certification assessment for commercial OEM delivery.

next_cycle_improvement_plan.title: Physical HIL Dyno Bench Testing & High-Frequency Noise Profiles
next_cycle_improvement_plan.description: Transition from virtual CAN transceiver emulation to physical hardware-in-the-loop dyno testbed with expanded capacitive noise injection patterns.

next_cycle_improvement_plan.title: Interactive Real-Time Web Dashboard for Measurement Metric Trends
next_cycle_improvement_plan.description: Deploy interactive web reporting UI visualizing automated coverage, defect turnaround, and complexity metrics for executive stakeholders.
